threat_scenario: Unauthorized Modbus write to control logic (MITRE T0831)
mitigation_controls: Purdue segmentation; gateway iptables allow-list restricting Modbus to HMI only (172.21.0.20); Scapy IDS rule UNAUTHORIZED_MODBUS_WRITE; Alertmanager paging; IR playbook IR_PLAYBOOK_PLC_TAMPERING.md

threat_scenario: Process safety violation via unsafe command sequence (MITRE T0836)
mitigation_controls: Physics-aware IDS rule PROCESS_SAFETY_VIOLATION (tank-level interlock shadowing); HMI login controls; gateway default-drop; operator manual-override procedure

threat_scenario: Network reconnaissance and scan of control zone (MITRE T0846)
mitigation_controls: Gateway default-drop firewall; no route from IT to control except via chokepoint; OT_BRUTE_FORCE_SCAN detection on Modbus exception floods; CROSS_ZONE_VIOLATION alerting

threat_scenario: Brute force or exception flooding against HMI and PLC Modbus server (MITRE T0846)
mitigation_controls: Scada-LTS user authentication; gateway rate limiting (partial); OT_BRUTE_FORCE_SCAN rule with 5-exception threshold; account lockout procedure (SR_1.1)

threat_scenario: DNP3 unauthorized write against field assets (MITRE T0831)
mitigation_controls: DNP3_WRITE_UNAUTHORIZED detection rule; gateway conduit filtering; protocol allow-listing; planned DNP3/TLS or tunneling (SR_4.1)

threat_scenario: Log tampering or deletion of audit evidence (Alerts_Log; InfluxDB ot_data)
mitigation_controls: Centralized JSON alert collection via Promtail to Loki (172.24.0.20); immutable/append-only target; Grafana SIEM (172.24.0.22) as read-only evidence store; SOC_Dashboard access restricted

threat_scenario: PLC logic tampering and persistence (MITRE T0853)
mitigation_controls: PLC_LOGIC_TAMPERED detection; master logic hash stored on EWS (172.23.0.4); golden logic files in offline vault; change-management (MOC) approval (SR_3.3); IR restore procedure
Historians isolated on ops_network (172.23.0.0/24, internal); no direct inbound exposure; gateway conduit control; backup strategy currently simulated (SR_7.3 Partial) - automated backups outstanding

threat_scenario: Insider threat via HMI compromise or misuse (stolen credentials)
mitigation_controls: Scada-LTS role-based access; multi-homed isolation (supervisory_network 172.22.0.0/24 + control 172.21.0.20); PROCESS_SAFETY_VIOLATION behavioral monitoring; background checks and least privilege (SR_2.1)

threat_scenario: Supply chain compromise of container images or dependencies
asset: Gateway alpine:3.19; OpenPLC runtime images; Kali attacker image
mitigation_controls: Pinned image tags; Trivy and pip-audit in CI; gitleaks secrets scan; signature verification on vendor images where available (SR_1.2)

threat_scenario: Denial of service on PLC network stack via Modbus flood (MITRE T0814)
mitigation_controls: Gateway rate limiting (partial); OT_BRUTE_FORCE_SCAN detection for early warning; PLC-side connection limits not yet implemented (SR_7.1 Partial)

threat_scenario: Passive sniffing of unencrypted Modbus/TCP traffic (MITRE T0869)
asset: Control network (172.21.0.0/24); HMI to PLC conduits
mitigation_controls: Layered zone isolation limiting sniffing surface; gateway segments L1-L4; no external access to control network; transition to Modbus/TCP Security or VPN tunnels required (SR_4.1 Partial)
